identity_result: All six Supplementary Table S1 voucher identifiers map one-to-one to six public runs and BioSamples through the exact numeric suffix in SampleName and the matching BioSample isolate attribute.
morph_result: Official NCBI runinfo and BioSample metadata contain no flower-colour, corolla, phenotype, morph, pigment or anthocyanin attribute for these six samples. No W/BP state is assigned.
interpretation: The public sequence accessions are now linked to the published vouchers, but the white-corolla versus bluish-purple-corolla mapping remains unavailable outside the labelled phylogenetic figure or other voucher/author evidence.
prohibited_inference: Do not infer W/BP from locality, elevation, herbarium, library number, read count, topology or the broad NCBI submitted name Cirsium japonicum var. japonicum.
